Company Description

This is Warehouse Country, and Christmas is our biggest season of the year 




Since 1982, Discount Barn has played an important role in everyday Kiwi life.  Every Christmas, millions of Kiwis head to their local red shed store for gifts, decorations, toys and festive essentials. Behind every great Christmas shop is a team making it happen, and we're looking for Nightfill Team Members to help keep our stores stocked, organised and ready for the festive rush. 




Whether you're looking for extra income, your first job, or a stepping-stone to a bigger career, this could be the perfect opportunity. Many of our seasonal team members go on to build long-term careers within Discount Barn Group or careers in retail. 




Fixed-term opportunities are available from mid-September through to mid-November, with employment continuing until around mid-January. 

Job Description

As a Nightfill Team Member, you'll help ensure our store is ready for another busy day in Warehouse Country. 




Working behind the scenes, you'll be responsible for unpacking stock, replenishing shelves, building displays, and making sure the store looks its best before the doors open each morning. 




Your work plays a key role in creating a seamless shopping experience for our customers, helping them find everything they need to make Christmas special. 




The hours of work for this position are generally between 7am and 3.30pm.




You will need to be available throughout the holiday period and be flexible with hours and days of work. Please note: if you are required to work past 10pm, you must be above 16 years of age. 




We also require all applicants to have current right to work in New Zealand.

Qualifications

What We're Looking For 




We're looking for people who: 




Take pride in getting the job done right 
Work well independently and as part of a team 
Have a positive attitude and strong work ethic 
Are reliable and happy to roll up their sleeves when things get busy 
Can undertake lifting, climb ladders, and be on their feet for extended periods 




We're especially keen to hear from people who have strong availability throughout December and over public holidays, because that's when the Christmas magic (and the Christmas rush!) is at its peak.




What We Can Offer You 




$25.42 per hour 
The opportunity for additional shifts as we move closer to Christmas 
Career pathways and development opportunities #StartHereGoAnywhere 
Ongoing training and support 
A fun, supportive team environment 
Team Member discounts, perfect for your own Christmas shopping 
Additional Information

Ready to spend Christmas in Warehouse Country? 




Apply now and help us create a great shopping experience for customers across the festive season. 




One final tip: AI can be a great tool when applying for jobs, but we want to hear from you. Tell us, in your own words, why you'd be a great fit for the team.
